biocontainers.name: bioconductor-clumsid
biocontainers.summary: Clustering of ms2 spectra for metabolite identification

biotools.summary: CluMSID is a tool that aids the identification of features in untargeted LC-MS/MS analysis by the use of MS2 spectra similarity and unsupervised statistical methods. It offers functions for a complete and customisable workflow from raw data to visualisations and is interfaceable with the xmcs family of preprocessing packages.
